name: Alice Nightmare
source:
"The girl who floats a pure smile
doesn't know the meaningful happiness."

19th century London, England. 
Alice Charlotte, the daughter of an earl with eyes of different colors, one blue and one green, and her twin sister Alice Evelyn, were ostracized by their father, the Earl, who considered them illegitimate children. 
The older sister was heartbroken that only her younger sister, Alice Evelyn, suffered nightly abuse from their biological father. 
Despite enduring cruel days, the daughters loved their father who continued to inflict suffering on them, and their mother who was consumed by madness. 
But to the other residents of the Earl's household, Alice Evelyn's presence was invisible.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/an/alicenightmare.htm]official website[/url]]
